summary: Short residential kerb beside a junction, homes 11-22 m away on its own side.

best_section.where: South kerb of Carinya Street, before the T-junction, beside the tree-screened garden

drivers.seclusion: Gardens and houses directly behind the kerb at 11-22 m; more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with no cars parked; room beside the lane is probably enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street at a junction, low volume.
drivers.convention: No parked campers seen; no signs.

flags: Witton Creek 53 m away, lowest 34.8 m so not flood-prone
sun_shade: Tree shade over the south kerb, mostly from the south-west; open to the east.
